infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BILLNOTE uses the camera to scan barcodes and take photos of your items.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BILLNOTE uses your location while you use the app to fill your GST state and for attendance only if you turn that on.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BILLNOTE needs photo access to pick item pictures and share bill PDFs.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BILLNOTE uses Bluetooth to print bills and labels on a wireless printer.
